accounting: Every byte in the declared range remains owned by one independent honest-C translation unit. There is no interior gap, shared reconstruction, assembly, matched-byte increase, or frontier movement. The matched and NonMatching byte figures are the two retail_bytes values in function_measurement; their sum is the recorded accounted_bytes figure.
